svg.text: Disc 40 OD x 3 thick with a ring standing 8 on it: 34 OD, 3 wall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 16 mm hole on the axis for the M16 cable gland.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two 2.8 mm holes across the ring, 4 up from the disc, opposite

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: each other, for the M3 screws (they self-tap into the ring).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the ring slides into the open end of the head until the disc

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: meets the tube; two M3 x 6 screws through the head wall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The gland goes through the 16 mm hole from below, nut inside.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the ring slides in by hand; the screw holes line up.
